boundary: Refined S5T human-interaction and adverse-quality query for OpenAlex development only; not a frozen search, eligibility decision, or PRISMA input. Refinement retains adverse bug-detection/reliability evidence and is not based on outcome direction.

queries.query: ("large language model" OR LLM OR ChatGPT) AND ("software testing" OR "unit test generation" OR "test case development" OR "test case generation") AND ("user study" OR "human-LLM" OR "human-AI" OR "manual effort" OR "human involvement" OR "developer preference" OR "bug detection" OR "test reliability")

sentinels.title: Preemptive, Buffered or Guided? Empirical Studies on Human-AI Interaction Strategies for Software Test Case Development
sentinels.rationale: Two user studies measure test quality, creativity, interaction time, and attention in LLM-assisted test-case development.

sentinels.title: No More Manual Tests? Evaluating and Improving ChatGPT for Unit Test Generation
sentinels.rationale: Empirical evaluation and user study cover generated-test correctness, sufficiency, readability, usability, and developer preference.

sentinels.title: Design choices made by LLM-based test generators prevent them from finding bugs
sentinels.rationale: Adverse evidence shows automated generators can validate faulty behavior and reject bug-revealing tests.

sentinels.title: Software Testing of Generative AI Systems: Challenges and Opportunities
sentinels.rationale: Testing a GenAI system is distinct from GenAI assisting software-delivery testing; retrieval is a precision warning.
